lyrics:
[Intro: stomp-clap beat, gang chant, no instruments yet]
Rock, paper, rock, paper
Rock, paper, kiss
Rock, paper, rock, paper
Rock, paper, kiss

[Verse 1: female lead, bright and teasing, guitars crash in]
Best of three and the loser buys the round
You throw scissors every time, I've got you figured out
Hands behind your back and a look across the booth
Count it down, I dare you, tell the truth

[Pre-Chorus: drums build, both voices]
One, two, three, shoot

[Chorus: gang chant, stomping beat, power chords]
Rock, paper, rock, paper
Rock, paper, kiss
Rock, paper, rock, paper
Rock, paper, kiss
Whoever wins, whoever wins
Nobody's losing this

[Verse 2: male tenor, soulful and playful]
Call your friends and tell them it's a tournament
Winner stays on, and I'm feeling confident
Paper covers rock but nothing covers you
Throw whatever, darling, I'll throw it too

[Pre-Chorus: drums build, both voices]
One, two, three, shoot

[Chorus: gang chant, stomping beat, power chords]
Rock, paper, rock, paper
Rock, paper, kiss
Rock, paper, rock, paper
Rock, paper, kiss
Whoever wins, whoever wins
Nobody's losing this

[Bridge: half-time, handclaps, both voices sweet]
Hold up, hold up
Is it a tie?
Then we go again
All night

[Final Chorus: full speed, everyone shouting, guitar lead]
Rock, paper, rock, paper
Rock, paper, kiss
Rock, paper, rock, paper
Rock, paper, kiss
Whoever wins, whoever wins
Nobody's losing this

[Outro: stomp-clap alone, one last shout]
Shoot
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 149 BPM, 4/4, A-flat major. A stomping, bouncing, cheerleader beat. Bratty, bright and very fast-moving.

VOICE: A woman with a bright, sweet, slightly nasal pop voice who sings verse 1 with a tease in it. A man with a soulful, agile tenor who takes verse 2. A gang of voices shouting the chant in unison, like a playground or a stadium.

INSTRUMENTS: A stomp-clap drum pattern with a huge, dry snare. Crunchy, palm-muted electric guitars opening into power chords. A buzzing synth bass. A bright new-wave synth line. Handclaps throughout. A short, squealing guitar lead in the last chorus.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, the chant over stomps and claps only. 0:13 Verse 1, the guitars crash in. 0:32 Pre-chorus, a counted 'one, two, three, shoot'. 0:36 Chorus 1. 0:58 Verse 2. 1:17 Pre-chorus. 1:21 Chorus 2. 1:43 Bridge, half time with handclaps. 1:59 Final chorus at full speed, twice through. 2:36 Outro, stomps and claps alone, a last shout at 2:46.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-2020s pop-punk revival with early-80s new-wave colour: loud, dry and punchy, drums huge, chant mixed like a crowd.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The chant in the first four seconds, before any instrument.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The game is one every generation and every country already knows, so nobody needs it explained. It suits a first date and a couple who have been deciding things this way for thirty years.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Play, flirtation, a tie, more play.
